test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: I, J, K, L, M, N and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. K sits fourth to the right of L. Only two people sit between M and I when counted from the left of M. J sits third to the left of R. N is an immediate neighbour of R and I. How many people between K and N when counted from the left of N?
solution:
**Given: **I, J, K, L, M, N and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

K sits fourth to the right of L, N is an immediate neighbour of R and I. Only two people sit between M and I when counted from the left of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c60cab05573a786bfdb46121033f9f4929b079a2de4cd5e746b82db330ecc6e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ce4befb49a2eae6712d1c7caf2a4f7fcd19d1003078b834324a2d85136eb7d0.png] 

 J sits third to the left of R. N is an immediate neighbour of R and I. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9ac321d21d1e603eecbc4369f5393f40fc89239560769b88019ff819f064985.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68d32e3a93e1cfc9a53679b8d6f785a0972e89fbef2eb593c85e3698812b6dad.png] 

Thus, Only 4 people between K and N when counted from the left of N.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
